faqs.q: How fast can I move in?
faqs.a: Most rooms are next-day move-in once you're approved, and approval is usually quick. If a room is available and you apply early enough in the day, same-day move-in is often possible too.
It's simple: apply, get approved by both PadSplit and our host team (usually the same day), pay your first week's rent, get your door code, and move in!
You pay your first week's rent to lock in the room, then get your move-in details and door code. From there you can move in right away — most homes are ready immediately.

faqs.q: What does it cost to move in?
faqs.a: Just a $19 application fee to apply — and it's refunded if you're not approved. Once you're approved, your first week's rent is due to move in. There's no big security deposit.

faqs.q: How does payment work and when is rent due?
faqs.a: Rent is paid weekly, in advance. Your first week is due when you move in, and after that it's charged automatically on the same weekday each week through PadSplit, using a linked bank account or card. Utilities and WiFi are included, so there are no separate bills.

Rent is billed weekly, in advance — that's how our billing works, so there isn't a monthly option. Your first week is due when you move in, and after that you're charged automatically on the same weekday each week. If weekly doesn't fit your schedule, you can ask us about paying bi-weekly instead.

faqs.q: Are there any other fees or hidden costs?
faqs.a: No hidden costs. Your weekly rent covers the room, all utilities, and WiFi. The only upfront items are the $19 application fee and your first week's rent. (Optional extras like double occupancy cost a little more.)

faqs.q: What do I need to get approved?
faqs.a: You'll need income of at least 2x the rent, and no felonies, violent misdemeanors, or evictions in the past 7 years. You're approved by both PadSplit's background screening and our host team — usually the same day.
There's no minimum credit score. Approval is based on a background screening and proof you earn at least 2x the rent — not a traditional credit check.

faqs.q: How do I show proof of income?
faqs.a: During your application you can upload recent pay stubs, a bank statement, or an offer letter. We generally look for income of about 2x the rent, and the application walks you through exactly what to provide.
Usually quick — often the same day. You're approved by both PadSplit's background screening (which runs automatically with your application) and our host team.
If you're not approved, your $19 application fee is refunded. You're welcome to apply to another home that might be a better fit.

faqs.q: Is the room furnished? What's in it?
faqs.a: Yes — every room comes fully furnished, typically with a bed, mattress, and storage, and the shared spaces like the kitchen and living room are furnished too. You just bring your personal belongings.
Yes, you get your own private bedroom with its own lock. Spaces like the kitchen, living room, and most bathrooms are shared with your housemates.
Some rooms have a private bathroom and others share — it's listed on each room. Private-bath rooms cost a bit more and tend to go quickly.
Your furnished room, all utilities, WiFi, and shared common areas — one weekly payment, no separate bills.

faqs.q: Can I use the kitchen and cook?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Every home has a shared, fully-equipped kitchen you're free to use, along with shared living spaces.
Yes — every home has a washer and dryer on site, included at no extra cost.
Most homes have street or driveway parking. It can vary by home, so check the specific listing if you'll be driving.

faqs.q: How many people live in each home?
faqs.a: These are shared co-living homes, so you'll have a handful of housemates, each with their own private room. The exact number varies by home and you can see the layout on each listing.

faqs.q: Can I tour a home before booking?
faqs.a: You can explore every room and common area through the photos and 3D tour on each listing — it's a full walkthrough of the home before you ever book.

Our homes run on a simple philosophy: be here and be happy. A few shared agreements keep everyone comfortable — it's residents only (no guests), smoke-free indoors (step outside to smoke or vape), and pet-free. Quiet hours are 9 PM–9 AM. Keep shared spaces tidy and wash your dishes right after using them, bring your own basics like toilet paper and soap, treat the home and furnishings with care, and be a good neighbor — resolve things kindly and report anything that needs fixing through PadSplit. Ask our assistant if you'd like more detail on anything.

faqs.q: Can I have guests or overnight visitors?
faqs.a: No — guests aren't allowed in the homes at any time, day or night. Everyone living there is vetted and background-checked, which keeps the community safe and comfortable for residents.
No smoking or vaping inside the homes. If you smoke, it needs to be outdoors — preferably in the backyard.
No, our homes are pet-free. To find a home for you and your furry friend, search here. (Registered service animals are considered separately, case by case.)

faqs.q: Can two people share a room?
faqs.a: Most rooms are single-occupancy. Some homes allow double occupancy for an additional fee — you can search for rooms that allow double occupancy here. (Bringing a child? Some homes allow it for a fee — use the same search to find family-friendly homes.)

faqs.q: Are the homes men, women, or mixed?
faqs.a: Most are mixed-gender co-living homes. You can browse what's available across our homes right on the site.

faqs.q: How long can I stay? Is there a minimum?
faqs.a: You can stay as long as you like — most residents stay 6–12 months. There's no long lease; you simply pay weekly. The details on minimum stay and move-out notice are in your PadSplit agreement.
Just give notice through PadSplit when you're ready — there's no long lease tying you down, and your agreement explains the notice period.

faqs.q: Can I switch rooms or homes later?
faqs.a: Often yes — if another room or home opens up and you're in good standing, you can usually move. Just apply to the new room on PadSplit when one becomes available.
We have homes across the Atlanta area — Decatur, South Atlanta, Stone Mountain, and Snellville. You can see each home's neighborhood on the map; the exact address is shared after you book.
It depends on the home — some are a short 5–10 minute walk to the bus, while others are better for residents who drive or rideshare. Ask our assistant about a specific home and we'll tell you.
Every resident is background-checked, and each room has its own electronic door lock for privacy and security.
If something needs fixing, submit a request through PadSplit and we'll take care of it. You're never on the hook for normal repairs.
Shared common areas are cleaned regularly, and several homes include monthly cleaning of those spaces. You keep your own room tidy.
It's not required, though you're welcome to insure your personal belongings if you'd like.

faqs.q: What is PadSplit and why do I book there?
faqs.a: PadSplit is the trusted platform we use to handle applications, screening, and secure weekly payments. When you tap “Book this room,” it takes you there to apply and pay for that exact room.

faqs.q: How do I get the exact address?
faqs.a: For residents' privacy, the exact street address is shared after you book. Each listing shows the neighborhood and a map area so you know where it is.
